Independent renewal-age/deficit inequality and Karamata reconstruction
correctness.rationale: For stationary iid alternating runs with finite mean m, equilibrium run age has survivor H(s)/m conditional on the sign. The deficit Z=(B-X)/(2B) decays as Z_entry exp(-kappa A) on a positive run. The preceding negative duration U gives Z_entry >=1-exp(-kappa U); hence any near-edge event with A<=(1-theta)s requires U=O(exp(-kappa theta s)), controlled by the stated lower-tail bound. Negative-current-run contribution is O(exp(-kappa s)). Squeezing H((1-theta)s)/H(s) by regular variation and letting theta down to zero gives P(X>B-eps)~H(kappa^-1 log(2B/eps))/(2m). Karamata gives H(s)~s P(T>s)/(alpha-1). For half-t, H(s)=sqrt(s^2+tau^2)-s and m=tau, yielding kappa tau/[4 log(2B/eps)] with the quoted relative error. This checks both sides, the normalization and the finite-mean boundary; it does not yield a density or arbitrary-force theorem.
residual_risks: Finite simulation diagnostics do not test infinite-family slowly varying tails.
The exact percentage error uses a nontrivial moving cutoff h~log(s); checked algebraically from the stated probability bound rather than claiming a stochastic certificate.

value.rationale: Support-edge mass is a natural observable, but the previously published theorem already gives the same physical mechanism, the stationary edge coefficient and the half-t inverse-log law. The sole formally new component is replacing a constant power-tail coefficient by an arbitrary slowly varying factor via Karamata in the identical renewal-bound argument; the source supplies neither a new difficult boundary nor a new structural insight, exact invariant, or application requiring that extra generality. The tail-exponent readout is likewise immediate from the preexisting power-tail statement. This is a routine extension rather than a motivated independent mathematical contribution under the shared value bar.
residual_risks: The larger slowly varying class is mathematically true, and another value judgment could assign significance to it; this assessment evaluates its incremental contribution relative to the matched prior theorem.

limitations: Strong published same-model pure-power and half-t coverage; no new scientific replacement submitted.
Rejected for incremental value, not false mathematics.
